purpose: Document first-party registry/map discovery, current viewer configuration, bounded anonymous request outcomes, and safety limits.
assessment: A local Lalpur Upazila Land Office is evidenced by an official Bangladesh government page. The current DLRS viewer JavaScript exposes anonymous hierarchy, GeoJSON-sheet, and parcel vector-tile routes, but the Lalpur/Natore branch did not yield a parcel response.
registryAssessment: Local custody is evidenced by the official Lalpur Upazila Land Office pages. DLRS is the national land-record and survey agency/viewer, not a substitute for proving citywide geometry.
